title: Combined tracking area updating procedure not accepted by the network

entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE for tracking area update that may be rejected by the network with various EMM cause values.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE when combined tracking area updating procedure is not accepted.

entities.name: EMM cause value
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for rejection of tracking area update request.

entities.name: Timer T3430
entities.description: Timer used during tracking area updating procedure that is stopped upon receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Back-off timer assigned by network for congestion control, started by UE upon receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT.

entities.name: MM IDLE
entities.description: State entered by UE after receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state entered by UE for various EMM cause values in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT.

entities.name: Message integrity protected
entities.description: Condition where TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message has integrity protection.

entities.name: Delete GUTI and related parameters
entities.description: UE action to delete GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI List and eKSI for certain EMM cause values.

entities.name: Set EPS update status
entities.description: UE action to set EPS update status to various values (EU2 NOT UPDATED, EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED) based on EMM cause.

relations.description: Procedure results in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message when not accepted by network.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message includes EMM cause value indicating rejection reason.
Upon receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT, UE stops timer T3430.
UE enters MM IDLE state after receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT.
Certain EMM cause values trigger UE to delete GUTI and related parameters.
EMM cause value determines which EPS update status UE should set.
Certain EMM cause values cause UE to enter EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
UE starts timer T3346 when TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT includes T3346 value IE.
Integrity protection condition determines UE behavior for TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message.
